name: Valley Expedition
description: Explore the valley's winding paths. Who knows what you'll find off the beaten trail.

objects.text: Survey Results: We found a few ore rich veins in this area but we've having trouble with the wildlife.

dialog.speaker: Scout
dialog.text: A few miners swore they saw something huge flying over the ridge last night. Scales, wings, the whole deal.

dialog.speaker: Scout
dialog.text: Guild sent me to check it out, but all I've found are these claw marks. Whatever it was, it's big.
